votes.motion: to approve the minutes from January 2, 2024

based on the information and findings set forth in the staff report and upon the evidence and explanations received today, to approve the Conditional Use Permit for Utah Xtreme Cheer, located at 8224 South Industry Circle in an M-1 zone with the condition #1 that is supported by substantial evidence as described in the analysis of section IV of the staff report. The condition is imposed to…

to approve a Conditional Use Permit for a Restaurant, Fast Food (General) use for Carroh Way Retail on approximately 0.56 acres at 2877 West 7800 South, subject to all conditions of approval 1 through 5

to approve a Preliminary Site Plan for Carroh Way Retail, a two-tenant fast food building located at 2877 West 7800 South, subject to all requirements of approval, removing the reference to 5600 West and adding: 4. Refresh the striping on Carroh Way as indicated in the Traffic Engineer’s memo

to recommend approval of the General Plan Map amendment, changing the designation for the 53.4 acres of Jones Landing North from Light Industrial and Future Park to Southwest Quadrant (subject to all requirements of approval.)
to recommend approval of the Master Development Agreement (subject to all requirements of approval)

to recommend approval of the Rezone of 53.4 acres from A- 20 (Agricultural 20-acre minimum lots) Zone and M-1 (Light Manufacturing) Zone to SWQ-MU (Southwest Quadrant Mixed-Use) Zone (subject to all requirements of approval)
